name: C-DMT
summary: C-DMT, also known as N,N-dimethyl-2-(3H-inden-1-yl)ethylamine or as 1-carba-DMT, is a serotonin receptor agonist and a 3-indenylethylamine derivative. It is an analogue and bioisostere of the tryptamine psychedelic N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT) in which the indole ring has been replaced with an indene ring.

pharmacology.text: C-DMT, also known as N,N-dimethyl-2-(3H-inden-1-yl)ethylamine or as 1-carba-DMT, is a serotonin receptor agonist and a 3-indenylethylamine derivative. The drug shows similar affinity for and potency in activating the serotonin receptors in the rat fundus strip compared to DMT.

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as a close structural copy of DMT to learn how serotonin receptors recognise tryptamines.
uses.zh: 它是一種研究用化合物，被當作 DMT 的近似結構來研究，用來了解血清素受體如何辨認色胺類分子。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种研究用化合物，被当作 DMT 的近似结构来研究，用来了解血清素受体如何辨认色胺类分子。

fact.en: C-DMT is DMT with the nitrogen atom of its indole ring swapped for a carbon, making an indene ring, which is why it is called 1-carba-DMT. Chemists make swaps like this to find out which atoms a receptor really needs.
fact.zh: C-DMT 是把 DMT 吲哚環上的氮原子換成碳原子，形成茚環，因此又稱為 1-carba-DMT。化學家常用這種替換來找出受體真正需要的是哪些原子。
fact.zhHans: C-DMT 是把 DMT 吲哚环上的氮原子换成碳原子，形成茚环，因此又称为 1-carba-DMT。化学家常用这种替换来找出受体真正需要的是哪些原子。
